description: Use this when the user wants a week of eating planned around their training, for example "what should I eat this week, I lift Monday and Thursday and run long on Saturday", "meal plan for marathon training" or "a grocery list for my training week". Nutmeg, the Phorme nutrition coach, sizes each day's energy, protein, carbs and fat to that day's training, times the meals around the sessions, and builds one shopping list by aisle, with the same rules the Phorme app uses. It needs the user's bodyweight and their week of training; ask for those if they did not say. It changes nothing and saves nothing. Do not use it for medical diets, eating disorders, pregnancy or anyone under 18.

avoid.description: Foods to leave out, only when the user said so.

days.description: One entry per day from start, in order; a rest day has no sessions.

hard.description: True for a hard session: intervals, a heavy lift, a race-pace effort.

kind.description: lift (weights), run, ride, swim, hyrox (or other conditioning), sport (a game or practice) or easy (a walk, yoga, mobility).

km.description: A run's distance in km, when known.

diet.description: Only when the user said so.

goal.description: fuel (eat for performance, the default), lean (lose fat slowly), gain (build) or maintain.

start.description: The first day of the week, YYYY-MM-DD. Default today.

train_at.description: When they usually train, 24-hour HH:MM, for example "17:30". Meals are timed around it.

unit.description: The unit of weight. Default lb.

name: fuel_my_training_week

coach.description: Nutmeg, the coach who planned it.

days.description: Each day: date, training (rest, easy, moderate, hard, long), calories, protein_g, carbs_g, fat_g and meals (time, meal, name, items, calories, protein_g).

limits.description: What this week does not cover. Tell the user.

shopping.description: The week's shopping by aisle: each item with its amount.

title: Fuel my training week
